verdict.rationale: BILL's developer site documents an llms.txt docs index for AI agents and serves markdown versions of every docs page when .md is appended. A live probe confirmed llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with structured content, and a dedicated AI agent resources page describes a documentation MCP server for Cursor, Windsurf and Claude Desktop. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents can use the docs effectively end to end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: For AI agents: the docs index is at https://developer.bill.com/llms.txt. Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown version.
PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://developer.bill.com/llms.txt # BILL API documentation Documentation
The BILL API documentation MCP server enables AI-powered code editors like Cursor and Windsurf, plus general-purpose tools like Claude Desktop, to interact directly with the BILL API documentation.
